reason: €600 is a lot when my daughter already does Instagram and my nephew said he could make something on Wix for nothing. I paid for a website once and it just sat there going stale, so I'm not rushing to pay again.
objection: I paid for a website before and nobody ever updated it. Why would this be different, and will I really get more direct bookings or just a nice page nobody finds?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another villa owner nearby who actually gets direct bookings from their site, and paying part of the €600 only after it brings me a booking or two.
